ctx.x: same reason you did. He was asked to double and he didn't get any extra money. But he quit. He didn't get fired.
He quit. Oh, he had a nice deal to go to. His wife was working in the Islands and they went down and worked together -- which is nice.
When you left, with Johnny and -- you and Johnny and who else left at the same time?
